playbook.note: Neuter: das Playbook, Plural Playbooks. Kept English per Weblate glossary.

run.note: Noun; masculine: der Durchlauf, Plural Durchläufe. Majority rendering (104 'Durchlauf' vs 35 'Lauf' occurrences — prefer Durchlauf and avoid 'Lauf'). Verb 'run a playbook' = 'Playbook ausführen'.

checklist.note: Feminine: die Checkliste. Checklist item = Checklistenpunkt (existing rendering).

status update.note: Existing strings mix 'Statusaktualisierung' and 'Status-Update'; prefer Statusaktualisierung. 'Post update' = 'Aktualisierung veröffentlichen'.

retrospective.note: Feminine: die Retrospektive. Consistent existing rendering.

follower.note: No existing rendering in Playbooks; keep the established social-software loanword (verb 'follow' = folgen, 'unfollow' = nicht mehr folgen, consistent with core product).

trigger.note: Existing rendering; consistent with 'trigger word' = Auslösewort in core.

key metrics.note: No existing rendering; keeps consistency with metric = Metrik (avoid 'Kennzahlen', which would break that pairing).

metric.note: Feminine: die Metrik. Existing rendering ('Metrik hinzufügen').

timeline.note: Majority rendering; one string uses 'Zeitplan' (inconsistent, avoid — Zeitplan means schedule).

stakeholder.note: Existing strings keep the loanword; 'Beteiligte' appears once as a paraphrase.

assignee.note: Majority rendering; 'Verantwortlicher' appears once (inconsistent). Prefer Bearbeiter.

filter.note: Masculine: der Filter. Verb: filtern ('Einträge filtern').

run channel.note: Existing strings mix 'Durchlauf-Kanal', 'Durchlaufkanal', and 'Kanal für den Durchlauf'; prefer the hyphenated form for readability.

broadcast.note: Existing rendering paraphrases: 'Broadcast update to selected channels' = 'Aktualisierungen an ausgewählte Kanäle senden'. Avoid literal 'übertragen'.

attribute.note: Consistent with core product; 'Property Fields' also renders as Attribute/Eigenschaftsfelder in newer strings.

section.note: Masculine: der Abschnitt. 'Add a section' = 'Abschnitt hinzufügen' (existing rendering).

run summary.note: Existing renderings: 'Durchlauf-Zusammenfassung' and 'Zusammenfassung des Laufs'; prefer the compound with Durchlauf for consistency with run = Durchlauf.
